TDrawingObject.MoveFieldBy.text: Moves a field of the object. Most objects have no fields, so nothing happens; a placed symbol moves the field's position (kept relative to the symbol).

params.Field: FIELD_BASE + the field's number, as FieldAt gave it

TDrawingObject.FieldAt.text: Is the point on a field of the object that can be dragged by itself? Most objects have none, so this is always -1; a placed symbol answers for its shown fields.

params.P: a point of the sheet (not snapped)
